turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good morning, please have a seat. What brings you in today?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I've had this dull pain in my lower back for about two weeks now.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Does the pain radiate down either leg, or stay in one place?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It shoots down my right leg sometimes, especially when I bend over.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Any numbness or tingling in the foot? Any trouble with bladder control?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Some tingling in the toes, but nothing else.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'll order an MRI of the lumbar spine and prescribe an anti-inflammatory.
